reads.stopped_at: If you’re curious about shaping clay by hand, the programme gives you the next place to look.
reads.what_it_sells: A beginner, instructor-guided hand-building pottery workshop where I could spend part of a weekend making a clay piece to collect after firing.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I am a local adult interested in trying a creative weekend activity, and the email offers a beginner creative workshop, so the premise fits. The email does not establish that the workshop is local to me, available on a weekend, affordable, or convenient; those practical details remain unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: interest in trying a creative weekend activity.
Email-only: curiosity about shaping clay by hand.
Email-only: willingness and ability to return later to collect a fired piece.
Unknown: prior pottery experience, familiarity with ClayRoom, location, budget, and weekend availability.
reads.problem_now: There is no urgent problem to solve. This is an optional leisure activity that matches an established interest, but the email gives me no time-sensitive reason to investigate it on this busy morning.
reads.biggest_doubt: I cannot tell whether the workshop is actually practical for me because the email gives no price, location, dates, duration, or collection timeframe.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me the price.
